# Copilot Instructions

This is **iris-ui**, a shared UI component library written in TypeScript and React.

## Project Overview
- Provides reusable UI components intended to be consumed by other projects and applications.
- Built with TypeScript for type safety and React for component authoring.
- Components should be generic, composable, and well-typed.

## Guidelines
- All components must be written in TypeScript with proper type definitions and exported interfaces.
- Follow React best practices (functional components, hooks, etc.).
- Keep components generic and reusable — avoid application-specific logic inside this library.
- Export all public components, types, and utilities from the library's index.
